description: Ask a question about the loaded dataset. AVA writes and executes the SQL, then summarizes the result. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY (and optionally OPENAI_MODEL / OPENAI_BASE_URL) in the server environment.

includeSummary.description: Whether to write a prose answer. Defaults to true.

question.description: The question to answer from the data.

name: ava_analyze
title: Answer a question in natural language
